title: Unitarian Church in Charleston
geometryBasis: Current named OpenStreetMap outline, two exact cleared Qualla exterior photographs, National Historic Landmark architectural description and the original elevation field.
sectionBasis: West facade in three bays, cream stucco on brick, Tudor entrance, tall hooded lancets, stepped wall pilasters, crenellated square belfry with four pinnacles, red gabled nave roof and small east extensions.
limitations: The tower elevation is scaled from photographs against the mapped church and documented lancet height. The proportions of some tracery, the back and the small roof projections are estimated. Interior and churchyard objects are outside the scope of this model.
